captures.area-M1: Native anonymous (exception transport) and named @IsTest (tagged terminal assertion) captures at 62.0 and 67.0, with per-row companions and custom labels. Rows L01-L13, L101-L107, L112, S01-S17 and their S1xx twins, and the Datetime arithmetic rows F01-F06 and F101-F104.
captures.b41-h2: Native check-only deploys with the row @IsTest class run inside the deploy, and executeAnonymous rows (ids ending -A) with a tagged terminal assertion, at 62.0 and 67.0. Rows H2L* (labels), H2S* (same-spelled receivers) and H2R* (an Account local spelled Contact; a same-spelled RecordType local).
captures.setter-value: Native check-only deploys (GATE3-01, GATE3-01C) and executeAnonymous rows (H2V-*) at 62.0 and 67.0: the implicit setter value against a same-named type.
captures.abstract-override: Native anonymous and named @IsTest captures at 62.0, 65.0, 66.0 and 67.0. Rows R014 and C014: Account.SObjectType after a same-spelled Account local inside an override.

normalization: Sources are the deployed bytes. Only the terminal observation transport is replaced for local execution. Named compile answers drop the deploy-only "Dependent class is invalid and needs recompilation" entries. Custom labels are the deployed CustomLabels metadata.
